meta.execution: Signal at T close, execution at T+1 open with slippage; final close forced at interval end.
meta.selection_rule: 2026YTD is used only as final validation; ranking uses 2021-2025 training metrics and train trend-capture penalties.

split_adjustment.handling: Cloud OHLC series appears continuously adjusted; no second split adjustment was applied.

current_app.formula: Entry: NVDA close breaks prior 15d high/low. Filters: NVDA close above/below EMA80; NVDA ROC80 > -8%; QQQ ROC60 > 2%; NVDA-QQQ ROC80 > 0%; ATR50% <= 6.0%. Exit: SMA40; 57d opposite channel; fixed stop 20%; trailing stop 24%; take profit 20%; ATR stop 2.0x; ATR trailing stop 4.0x; max hold 20d.

closest.formula: Entry: NVDA close crosses SMA10. Filters: NVDA close above/below EMA200; NVDA close above/below EMA80; NVDA ROC40 > -6%. Exit: trailing stop 16%; take profit 8%.

Entry: NVDA ROC80 > 0%; short threshold 0%. Filters: NVDA close above/below EMA80; QQQ SMA150 filter; NVDA-QQQ ROC20 > 10%. Exit: qualified reverse signal; EMA100; fixed stop 32%; trailing stop 28%; take profit 8%; ATR stop 3.0x.
Entry: NVDA close breaks prior 65d high/low. Filters: NVDA close above/below SMA150; NVDA ROC20 > 6%; QQQ SMA150 filter. Exit: qualified reverse signal; 37d opposite channel; ATR trailing stop 3.0x.

closest_state_switch.formula: Regime: uptrend when NVDA close > EMA80, slope20 >= 0.0005, ROC60 >= -3%, ADX20 >= 20; range when ADX14 <= 20 and slope/ROC are muted; downtrend when close < SMA80 with negative slope/ROC. Uptrend long entry: regime; exit by EMA80 or ATR10 trailing 3.0x / stop 2.5x / no trend max-hold / no fixed trend take-profit. Range entry: none; range take-profit 12%, stop 6%, max hold 30d. Shorts enabled in downtrend.

Regime: uptrend when NVDA close > SMA100, slope20 >= 0.0, ROC120 >= -6%, ADX20 >= 20; range when ADX20 <= 25 and slope/ROC are muted; downtrend when close < SMA50 with negative slope/ROC. Uptrend long entry: regime; exit by SMA80 or ATR14 trailing 3.0x / stop 3.5x / no trend max-hold / wide take-profit 40%. Range entry: none; range take-profit 30%, stop 10%, max hold 60d. Shorts enabled in downtrend.

Regime: uptrend when NVDA close > EMA50, slope20 >= 0.0, ROC60 >= 3%, ADX30 >= 18; range when ADX14 <= 25 and slope/ROC are muted; downtrend when close < SMA120 with negative slope/ROC. Uptrend long entry: regime; exit by SMA20 or ATR30 trailing 5.0x / stop 1.5x / no trend max-hold / no fixed trend take-profit. Range entry: none; range take-profit 8%, stop 6%, max hold 60d. Downtrend uses flat/no-new-long mode.

closest_no_small_take_profit.formula: Entry: NVDA close breaks prior 65d high/low. Filters: NVDA close above/below SMA150; NVDA ROC20 > 6%; QQQ SMA150 filter. Exit: qualified reverse signal; 37d opposite channel; ATR trailing stop 3.0x.

Regime: uptrend when NVDA close > EMA80, slope20 >= 0.0005, ROC60 >= -3%, ADX20 >= 20; range when ADX14 <= 20 and slope/ROC are muted; downtrend when close < SMA80 with negative slope/ROC. Uptrend long entry: regime; exit by EMA80 or ATR10 trailing 3.0x / stop 2.5x / no trend max-hold / no fixed trend take-profit. Range entry: none; range take-profit 12%, stop 6%, max hold 30d. Entry: NVDA ROC60 > -10%; short threshold -4%. Filters: NVDA close above/below EMA80; NVDA close above/below EMA150; QQQ EMA200 filter; NVDA-QQQ ROC120 > 5%; ATR20% <= 4.5%. Exit: qualified reverse signal; fixed stop 15%; trailing stop 24%; take profit 30%; ATR trailing stop 3.5x; max hold 74d.
